title: Decisions on Tree-cutting and Replanting Activities within Estates
what_it_is: Decisions on Tree-cutting and Replanting Activities within Estates

sections.label: Tree removal and replanting
sections.summary: NParks removes trees in poor health, for public safety or development, assesses them first, and studies replanting options.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Trees are removed when they are in poor health, when they impact public safety or when there are development works.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Prior to removal, NParks' arborists carry out professional assessments to decide if a tree can be saved or transplanted.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: When there is no choice but to remove a tree, NParks will study replanting options at the site.

sections.label: Resident consultation on landscaping
sections.summary: Residents are consulted on estate landscaping rejuvenation, including feedback on options and tree planting schemes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Page: 9 Residents are consulted when there is an opportunity to rejuvenate the overall landscaping of the estate.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: For example, NParks seeks feedback on landscaping options and tree planting schemes as part of the Estate Upgrading Programme and for large projects like Jurong Lake Gardens.

sections.label: Feedback on tree selection
sections.summary: NParks gathers feedback on tree maintainability, risk and biodiversity, and plants varied species for nature ways.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: NParks, over the years, would have obtained lots of residents' feedback, feedback from municipal agencies as well about the maintainability of a tree, the risk structure of particular types of trees given their height, their crown and the incidence of branch falling or how frequently the leaves are shed, making things difficult for the cleaning companies; but also for biodiversity reasons.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: So, some street scape forms part of nature ways where we try to plant a variety of plants and tree species in order to provide connections between areas of biodiversity.

sections.label: NParks and HDB consultation
sections.summary: NParks and HDB consult each other, NParks trains Town Council horticulturists, and they share learning with HDB staff.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: NParks and HDB closely consult each other and NParks provides training to Town Councils' horticulturists, but they also share their learning experience with the HDB staff which Town Councils will approach when they want to make changes to the tree types within the municipal areas that they are responsible for.
